scale_context.aligner_policy: This summary reads completed branch-conditioned 100K outputs and inherits the production-fast aligner-policy context: identity, MAFFT, BABAPPAlign, and MUSCLE. It does not run alignments, neural training, 10K generation, or 100K generation.
scale_context.executive_conclusion: Conservative explicit branch-truth workflow is technically validated at 100K scale. Extreme-tier performance remains strong but reduced relative to low/moderate tiers. Branch-level and gene-level aggregation are strong. Results support moving from bulk simulation validation to targeted ablation, empirical pilot, and manuscript integration work.
